packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
PACKET-06 - unverified blind image reading

Exposure statement: Nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or
reading of this text. I opened only PROMPT.md and the image files in this packet
(plus a directory listing of the packet folder and a pixel-size check with sips).
I did not use the web, any catalogue, or packet.json.

Conventions: (abc) = proposed expansion; word? = uncertain reading;
[illegible] = could not read; [?] = a letter group seen but not resolved.
Line numbers count text lines from the top of each tile image. Tiles overlap;
overlapping lines are marked "= image-NNN Lx" and not counted as new text.

======================================================================
LAYOUT SURVEY (observations)
======================================================================
Two faces of one leaf (overviews image-001 and image-010), each with two
columns of Gothic textualis, approx. 46-50 lines per column. Leaf is trimmed,
folded at the edges, damaged at the outer edge and lower corner; a horizontal
fold/strip across each face has abraded 2-4 lines (face 1 col. a near the fold,
col. b around the middle).
Face 1 (image-001): modern pencil note top right "Stams, STA, Fog. 76r" (as
it appears). Top left a red letter "A" followed by faint brown "...ue maria"
(reads like "[A]ue maria", a header/invocation line; uncertain). Small
blue/red penwork marks in upper margin.
 - col. a: red rubric mid-line (line 3 of text) "Capitulum .xv. ..." with a
   blue/red penwork initial (looks like an H/E-form) and a red-ink border
   line in the left margin; one marginal note in the left margin (image-003,
   red/brown, vertical, unread).
 - col. b: rubric "Capitulum .xvi. de visu lucenciu(m)" with a large red
   initial I extending several lines.
Face 2 (image-010): pencil notes in the upper margin: "aus Einband zu?
Homer Odyssee, Dillingen 1627" (approximate reading of a modern pencil note),
"III d/M 44", and "Stams, STA, Fog. 76v". Red/blue running-title fragments at
top centre ("II" with penwork) and top right ("O"/"Q" with penwork).
 - col. a: rubric "Capitulu(m) .xvii. de auditu ..." with a blue/red penwork
   initial N (or D) and red border flourishes.
 - col. b: rubric "Capitulum .xviii. Q(ua)liter sonus generatur in aere et
   in aqua" (red, interleaved with black text lines) with a large red initial A
   with long descender.
Red-touched capitals (paragraph marks) in the text. No interlinear glosses
seen. No underlining except one stroke over a word (image-005 L9, image-009
L7) that looks like an ink/drag mark.
Tentative interpretation: continuous prose treatise in numbered chapters on
vision (vacuum, mirrors, luminous bodies), then smell and hearing/sound. No
lemma/commentary split is visible; it reads as a single continuous text.

======================================================================
SPANS SELECTED
======================================================================
Face 1 col. a: nearly the whole column (image-002 to image-005).
Face 1 col. b: nearly the whole column (image-006 to image-009).
Face 2 col. a: nearly the whole column (image-011 to image-014).
Face 2 col. b: nearly the whole column (image-015 to image-018).
Unread/weak: lines on the horizontal fold on each face; the abraded line at
image-005 L12; faint lines image-007 L11-L16; the cropped lower right corner of
face 1 col. b; a faint ghost line above face 1 col. b (image-006 top).
